title: Record page v3 body tables total every number column — a version number and an instalment number are summed into 「本页合计 版本号 10 / 期次 15」
body:
repo:hotclm#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUw8KJgAwuwk6sqYLD

Filing gate: ① user-visible defect, reproduced in the browser on @objectstack 18.3.0 (hotclm 18.3 upgrade pass; hotclm decision-box batch 11, maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-03T16:16:59Z).

**Symptom.** On a hotclm contract page the full-width body tables (`relatedList: 'primary'` via `inlineEdit`) end in a totals line. It adds up every `number` column, including ordinals:
- 合同版本 (versions v1–v4): **「本页合计 版本号 10」** — 1+2+3+4.
- 收付款计划 (5 instalments): **「本页合计 期次 15 · 计划金额 3,380,500 · 实际金额 1,352,200」** — the instalment number summed, and the two amounts of a EUR contract summed with no currency.

**Where.** `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` `BodyTableTotals`: `TOTALLED_FIELD_TYPES = {currency, number, integer, decimal}` totals any column of those types (objectstack#27055 Target 8). `clm_contract_version.version_no` and `clm_payment_plan.seq` are `Field.number` with `scale: 0` — identifiers, not quantities — and there is no field- or list-level way to say "do not total this column". The currency branch only reads `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency`, so a `number` amount whose currency lives in the parent's `currency_code` prints bare.

**Expected capability.** Totals only where the author says a column is additive (an opt-in on the field or on the related list), or at least an opt-out; and amounts formatted in the record's currency when one is declared.

Evidence: /mnt/project-files/hotclm-objectstack-18-3-upgrade/02-detail-counsel-2.png and -3.png. Platform version: 18.3.0.
